issues.passage: Jurors treated the extraneous testimony as decisive proof of the defendant's guilt.
issues.why: Extraneous is used correctly here (irrelevant testimony); the sentence just reports jurors wrongly elevating it. Valid natural English, not a misuse.

fix.correctPassage: The editor removed extraneous examples that distracted from the main claim.
wrongPassages: The extraneous premise was the one claim on which the whole argument rested.
Counsel called the extraneous documents the heart of the prosecution's case.
Her extraneous outline listed only the steps the research team actually needed.
